description: November 27 birthday meaning: Sagittarius decan 1, birthday number 9, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, a November 27 birthday falls in Sagittarius, in the first decan, with Jupiter as the sign's ruler and Jupiter as the decan's. In numerology the day gives birthday number 9. The Life Path also uses the birth year. Sagittarius is mutable and fire.

sections.heading: The November 27 birthday in astrology
paragraphs: Few combinations look as broad-minded as November 27. Five degrees of Sagittarius, in the Jupiter-ruled first decan, emphasises generosity and a worldwide perspective, and twenty-seven reduces to 9, linked with humanitarian ideals. This birthday is traditionally associated with teachers, travellers and volunteers, people who feel most alive when their world gets a little larger.

Astronomically, November 27 puts the Sun near 5° Sagittarius in most years, inside the first ten-degree slice of the sign, which tradition links with Jupiter. Jupiter rules Sagittarius and presides over its first decan as well, from about November 23 to December 1. This is traditionally the most expansive, optimistic stretch of the sign. Natives are often described as adventurous, generous and philosophical, eager to travel, learn and share whatever they have discovered. Humour and candour come easily, and so can a tendency to say the true thing a little too bluntly. Doubled Jupiter can make commitments multiply faster than time allows. These Archers tend to thrive when their search for meaning has room to roam but also somewhere to come home to.

sections.heading: Birthday number and Life Path for November 27
paragraphs: Born on the 27th, you carry the compound 2 + 7 = 9. The 2 adds sensitivity, the 7 adds depth and reflection, and the 9 that results is compassionate and wide-ranging. People born on this day are often described as wise beyond their years, drawn to teaching, counselling or creative work that helps others make sense of things. Their emotional insight can be striking. Taken as a secondary number, the 27 is traditionally associated with leadership through understanding rather than force. Accepting differing views with patience tends to strengthen their influence over time.

Add the birth year and the picture shifts again: a November 27 birthday gives Life Path 3 for 1990, 22 for 2000, 5 for 2010 and 6 for 2020. Some birth years on this date reach the master numbers 11 and 22. Read the birthday number as a secondary note beside that main theme.

sections.heading: Season, Chinese zodiac and famous November 27 birthdays
paragraphs: A November birthday falls in late autumn for the northern hemisphere, a season of bare branches and early dusk, and in late spring for the southern, when the days lengthen fast. Scorpio holds most of the month, with Sagittarius arriving around November 22. In numerology November is month 11, a master number that is traditionally kept unreduced and linked with intuition and inspiration. November 27 is the 331st day of the year (332nd in a leap year). Counting forward, the next sign change, into Capricorn, is usually complete within 25 days, by December 22.

By November 27 the Chinese new year is well under way, which means the animal and element are those of the calendar birth year. Among the best-known people with a November 27 birthday are Bruce Lee (1940), Jimi Hendrix (1942) and Yulia Tymoshenko (1960).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is November 27?
faq.answer: November 27 is Sagittarius in every year from 1930 to 2030, wherever you were born. It falls in the first decan of Sagittarius, which tradition links with Jupiter.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on November 27?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On November 27 the Life Path is 9 in 1960, 1 in 1970, 11 in 1980, 3 in 1990, 22 in 2000, 5 in 2010 and 6 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 9 for everyone born on the 27th.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on November 27?
faq.answer: For the Chinese zodiac, Lunar New Year has always passed by November 27, so the animal is simply the one for the birth year.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on November 27?
faq.answer: Well-known people born on November 27 include Bruce Lee (1940), Jimi Hendrix (1942) and Yulia Tymoshenko (1960). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
